animation_sequence_packages.method: packages whose export table includes an AnimSequence export (Cue4Inspect --scan-export-classes over the full raw extraction, summarized by porting/asset_pipeline/animation_inventory.py; export class names only, exports not deserialized). Not a name heuristic.

apollo_streaming_levels.method: regex '(\d+) absent streaming levels' in the tracked map_compatibility.md report

asset_registry_counts.method: per-class counts printed by the asset registry dump: 'ClassName: N' lines, keyed by class name (Blueprint, WidgetBlueprint, World = maps, SoundWave, AnimBlueprint, ...)

cooked_mesh_exportable.method: SM_/SK_ name counts minus basenames in porting/asset_pipeline/nonmesh_packages.json, whose every Cue4Inspect --export-glb attempt reported 'Package has no static mesh export' (generated by classify_nonmesh.py; Blueprints, physics assets, skeletons and animations that merely carry a mesh-style name).

cooked_name_prefix_counts.method: NAMING-CONVENTION HEURISTIC, not asset class. Distinct .uasset basenames matching re.search per class over all 31 paks (full tree walk, --count-tree): static_mesh = basename matches ^SM_; skeletal_mesh = basename matches ^SK_; material = basename matches ^(M|MI|MF)_; texture = basename matches ^T_; animation = basename matches ^A_; niagara = basename matches ^NS_. Case-sensitive. Animation and material counts include only these prefixes.

cooked_non_mesh_distinct_names.method: distinct cooked .uasset basenames excluding case-sensitive SM_ and SK_ prefixes; derived from the full-tree distinct basename and disjoint prefix counts

cooked_uasset_distinct_names.method: distinct .uasset basenames over all 31 paks (full tree walk, --count-tree)

cooked_uasset_entries.method: distinct '.uasset' paths in the verified full raw extraction of all 31 paks (extract-full-summary.json byExtension['.uasset'].files; one path per package, duplicates across paks counted once)

native_functions_engine_provided.method: functions with an exec_addr that the stock UE 4.25 headers declare with a matching parameter count (declaration-level evidence from porting/engine_natives.py; Epic fork body differences are not tested)

native_functions_total.method: functions in reflection/native_funcs.json, over all classes

native_functions_with_exec.method: functions in reflection/native_funcs.json with a non-null exec_addr, excluding those the stock UE 4.25 engine source declares with a matching signature (progress/engine_provided_natives.json); ported bodies are measured against this denominator

pak_files_total.method: pak files in the full extraction (extract-full-summary.json pakCount; 31)

pak_full_distinct_paths.method: distinct pak paths over all 31 paks (extract-full-summary.json uniquePaths, duplicates across paks counted once); the denominator of the raw extraction leaf assets.pak_extraction

sound_class_mix_packages.method: NAMING-CONVENTION HEURISTIC: distinct cooked .uasset paths whose full path (folder or name) matches /SoundClass|SoundMix/. Sound class and mix packages are mostly in SoundClasses or SoundMixes folders, so a basename rule would miss them. Full tree walk (--count-tree).

uht_class_blocks.method: UHT class blocks: one entry per block address in reflection/class_parent_map.json

uht_classes_named.method: UHT class blocks with a recovered name: non-empty values in reflection/class_name_map.json

uht_classes_named_by_package.method: named UHT classes per package: the named class_name_map.json blocks grouped by the 'package' field of class_parent_map.json at the same block address

uht_classes_named_commonui_umg.method: named UHT classes in /Script/CommonUI plus /Script/UMG (the CommonUI and UMG leaf)

uht_delegates.method: entries in the 'delegates' list of reflection/delegate_blocks.json (construct-function join)

uht_enums.method: entries in the 'enums' list of reflection/enum_blocks.json (construct-function join)

uht_fortnitegame_name_matches.method: named /Script/FortniteGame classes whose name matches each regex (re.search on the class name): keys are the regexes used by the gameplay leaves in components.json

uht_structs.method: entries in the 'structs' list of reflection/struct_blocks.json (construct-function join)
